title: The River That Couldn't Smile
intro: This quiz follows Maya, Leo, and Grandpa Arun as they learn how plastic pollution harms rivers and wildlife—and how people can help.

questions.prompt: Why did the river look sad?
choices: The water had dried up
Plastic bottles and wrappers were polluting it
The fish had all moved away
The bridge was broken
questions.explanation: The river looked sad because plastic bottles and wrappers were polluting it.

questions.prompt: Why can plastic be dangerous to turtles?
choices: Turtles may mistake plastic bags for jellyfish
Plastic makes the water too cold
Turtles use plastic to build nests
Plastic makes turtles swim too fast
questions.explanation: Turtles may mistake plastic bags for jellyfish, which can make them very sick.

questions.prompt: How did much of the plastic reach the river?
choices: Fish carried it there
It grew in the water
Wind and rain moved it from the land
The river created it
questions.explanation: Much of the plastic reached the river when wind and rain moved it from the land.

questions.prompt: What did the River Rescue Team do?
choices: They added more water to the river
They collected litter, recycled plastic, and planted flowers
They moved the animals to another river
They built a new bridge
questions.explanation: The River Rescue Team collected litter, recycled plastic, and planted flowers.

questions.prompt: What is the main lesson of the story?
choices: Only adults can protect rivers
One good choice does not matter
Many people making small good choices can create a big change
Plastic disappears quickly in nature
questions.explanation: The main lesson is that many people making small good choices can create a big change.
